concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-your-payment-terminals]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured POS Terminal fleet Scheduled report field guide for one-row-per-terminal inventory, account/time-zone scope, last-online status and 14-day timestamp omission; not live device-state or payment-result proof.
warnings: `Switched off` is defined as last online more than a week ago in this report, not a live power measurement.
`Last Transaction` is only a timestamp and is omitted after 14 days; this is not a payment log or outcome report.
Company/merchant availability does not define user-role permissions or cross-account completeness.
